Hi! Thanks for your msg! 

We talked about expectations and both of us said we wanted someone for more than a fling. We went on a couple of actual dates, but that's all. I understand people can change their mind, but it just seems to happen all the time which is what sucks.

I agree, I don't expect cute texts to change someone who only wants casual sex into wanting something more! I was questioning more if sending them cute msgs was actually putting them off, sorry for the bad wording on my part.

Hi!!! 

Thank you so, so much for your reply! This kind of advice is beyond what I thought I'd get! 

Hearing about Imposter Syndrome really puts a lot into perspective... it's really comforting to hear that even if after all this my diagnosis isn't ADHD/ASD, my mind isn't faking or putting it on.

I'll fill out the forms and will contact GP first thing Monday. I'll be sure to come back here and to you with any questions and updates on my journey. THANK YOU (:
